name: Albassam · Falaj
description: Aziz's private family fund: one spring whose water reaches each member by their share. v4.1 'Falaj' (2026-10-07): a scroll-scrubbed hero film of an Arabian falaj channel, a deep-water canvas sampled from the footage, and one plain table of shares, money put in, worth today and zakat. Shares follow the money put in. The v4 dividend calculator was removed at Aziz's request.

logo.notes: Logo A, 'the channel': one stroke from a spring that splits into three branches ending in three basins, inside a rounded square. Limestone strokes, spring-water basins. It is the fund model drawn: one pool, every share. No raster logo; the site is noindex.

colors.name: Deep water
colors.usage: page canvas, sampled from the deepest shadow of the hero's final frame (#13332E); a slow caustic shimmer layer and faint light glints drift over it

colors.name: Shade pool
colors.usage: panels, payslips, the burn card: vertical gradients #1D4842 to #183F3A with a 1px rgba(237,230,216,.10) hairline

colors.name: Sandstone
colors.usage: secondary text and subtitles (6.4:1 on the canvas); faint tier #A89A82 (5.0:1) for labels and chart axes

colors.name: Hair
colors.usage: hairlines and dividers, written as rgba(237,230,216,.10) and .20 over the canvas

colors.name: Spring water
colors.usage: the one accent: CTAs, share figures, share previews, focus rings. Rare doses only

colors.name: Clay
colors.usage: losses, money out, errors, destructive actions only (6.1:1 on the canvas). Gains use #93D3A8

voice.tone: Calm, safe, custodial, and plain. Water words (spring, share) and everyday money words (put in, worth today, money in, money out). Sentence case, short lines, no exclamation points, no finance jargon (units, NAV, redeem). English only (Arabic script removed by the owner on 2026-07-06 and reconfirmed on 2026-09-28). Keep it simple: no extra ratios or calculators unless Aziz asks.
messagingPillars: Shares follow the money each person put in.
See the new shares before you save.

imagery.style: One world: an ancient Arabian falaj photographed straight down in soft early-morning light. The hero film descends from the channel into a round basin.
subjects: the falaj channel and its basins
imagery.treatment: Top-down, calm, photoreal, generated on Higgsfield (GPT Image 2.5 stills, Seedance 2.5 video). Every asset shares the palette and light of the hero; no text or logos in imagery. Captions over footage use soft oval scrims (closest-side radial) audited at >= 3.5:1 worst-pixel contrast.

layout.spacing: sections 72-128px apart; 20px to 6vw side gutters; max width 1280px
postureRules: The hero is a pinned 400vh scroll-scrubbed film (Tier 1, one 6-second shot) with three caption bands; phones and reduced motion get a composed still hero over the final frame.

Motion: the scrubbed film, one entrance per section (rise with a short stagger that retires), the slow environment layer, a water line drawing down the left gutter, basin ripples. Transform and opacity only. Everything pinned under reduced motion.
The office is private: nothing reads data before the owner's Google sign-in; Firestore rules enforce it.

Below the hero, keep it simple: the fund table (share, put in, worth today, zakat a year), money in and out with a live share preview, and a folded history. No calculators or extra ratios unless Aziz asks.
